title: The Naked Truth
cn: 第 2 集 · 赤裸真相
novel: Marshall [[worried|worry]] that some old [[videos|video]] from his past might ruin his chances of getting his dream job. He had been [[wild|wild]] in college and done some embarrassing things on camera. He and Ted searched [[frantically|frantically]] to find the tapes before anyone else could see them. Meanwhile, Ted could not [[decide|decide]] who to bring to the Architects Ball. He had met two different girls and [[attracted|attract]] both of them. Ted [[weighed|weigh]] the [[pros|pro]] and cons of each girl carefully. One was smart and [[elegant|elegant]], while the other was fun and [[spontaneous|spontaneous]]. Ted [[struggled|struggle]] with the [[decision|decision]] for days. He asked his friends for advice, but they all had different [[opinions|opinion]]. Marshall finally [[discovered|discover]] the old tape and watched it with horror. It was just as [[embarrassing|embarrassing]] as he remembered. He [[practically|practically]] begged his friends to help him destroy it. In the end, Marshall faced his potential employers and told the truth about his past. To his surprise, they were [[impressed|impress]] by his honesty. Ted eventually chose a girl for the ball, but things did not go as [[planned|plan]]. The evening turned into a [[disaster|disaster]] when he accidentally called her by the wrong name.

frantically.en: in a hurried and worried way

decide.en: to make a choice about something

struggle.en: to try hard to do something difficult

decision.en: a choice you make about something

discover.en: to find something for the first time

plan.en: to think about and decide in advance
